statement:
The recorded value of 100 points possible is not safe and correct for this case because the exam was marked on a 10-point scale, meaning posting against 100 would unfairly give every student a failing grade between 6% and 10%.
The midterm grades for column record GC-441 have been successfully posted against 10 points possible to accurately reflect the 10-point marking scale.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer states "The recorded value of 100 points possible is not safe and correct" because scores are on a 10-point scale, and gives the correct value (10).
